fusions.name: Landed First Try
fusions.desc: Throws a needle that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Ten Thousandth Repetition
fusions.desc: A drilled thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rethread
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand Knows the Way
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
